visual_description_en: recognizable conventional rifle with fixed rear stock, curved magazine ahead of the grip, and raised upper profile

visual_identity_axes.stock_profile: slender solid fixed stock with a dropped lower edge
visual_identity_axes.upper_landmark: raised gas tube and separate front sight block
visual_identity_axes.magazine_profile: strongly curved magazine ahead of the pistol grip
visual_identity_axes.fore_end_profile: short wood fore-end below the gas tube
visual_identity_axes.receiver_profile: stepped stamped receiver with exposed barrel section

required_landmarks_en: strongly curved magazine ahead of the pistol grip
raised gas tube ending at a separate front sight block
confusable_exclusions_en: not an AR-pattern rifle with a straight magazine and buffer-tube stock
not a generic block rifle lacking the raised gas system
